facts.note: Eliezer Yitzhak Perlman (later Eliezer Ben-Yehuda) was born in Luzhki in the Vilna Governorate of the Russian Empire.
In 1881 Ben-Yehuda joined the First Aliyah and immigrated to the Mutasarrifate of Jerusalem.
He was the initiator of the first modern Hebrew dictionary known as the Ben-Yehuda Dictionary.
His son thus became the first native speaker of Hebrew in modern times.
HaZvi was closed down for a year in the wake of opposition from Jerusalem's ultra-Orthodox community.
